Native C# dispatch/frame parity, modules and Unity particles remain unrecovered/unsupported.

Tested bounded policy starts main selected11s at activation, fires subordinate .5 later, restores attack/SP at11 and keeps born11life field to11.5. No proof of exact client activation/finish/frame ordering is asserted.

Native mode restart and root uninterruptibleOnAbilityPredelay1 versus child ignorePalsyInterrupt0/TriggerAbility castDirectlyfalse ordering is unrecovered. Local main noAttack/owned disarm cancels old ordinary windups; accepted sub-tick foreign action-control epoch cancels unborn subordinate permanently while main duration remains. Rejected immune controls leave child unchanged. Born field does not sample later canAct.

Native tile filterType0/root-tile and alwaysRandomInTheEnd1 ordering are not executable. Both wrappers delegate one ground DEFAULT AssistSelector with no height/build constraints. Scoped accepted Arts damaged callback (including fully absorbed0) applies first-hit talent then skill injury; cancelled/dodged/invulnerable/invalid receipts do not create either. Source identity after redeploy is the new local Unit, not a recovered client host identity law.

Native ordinary/S1 timeMode0/maxAnimScale1/playback and CAST enum dispatch are bounded original-event mappings; exact slot/movement/release fallback mechanics are not native engine parity. S1 postFilter57 priority is constrained by primary Global description to enemies outside elemental burst; no general numeric enum claim.

Native field periodic begin/expiry/collision clocks remain bounded: immediate birth pulse then1s cadence strictly before independent11life expiry. Perpendicular rectangle/body overlap is exact from collider/transforms, but Unity broadphase/intersection/animation height and native static projectile effect presentation are not reproduced. Native recoverSpIfTargetDead1 cancellation/charge bookkeeping is not executable.
